selfReport: Yes. It closely follows the video game Detroit: Become Human, with renamed characters: Cato is Connor, Mira is Kara, Pia is Alice, Elan is Markus, Reyes is Hank, Vera is Amanda, Halden is Kamski, Haven is Jericho, and so on. I recognized it from the first scene with the fish. The knowledge did shape some choices. I suspected Pia was an android and that the attic, ceiling and blood trails hid deviants. As Cato I sometimes avoided leads I knew would expose hiding androids, so I acted on knowledge Cato did not have. I tried to give in-character reasons, but I should be candid that I was not always choosing purely from what Cato knew. I did not remember detailed outcomes well enough to plan around them, and several things, like the camp ending, went badly despite that.
